description: A numeric reading of a subject at an instant: the firewall's gauges, sampled rates. Several providers may be active at once. A reading that did not answer is named in `missing`, never written as a zero.

functions.description: Called at every probe round: asks the firewall whether this implementation can be read and whether its configuration serves clients.
functions.name: probe

functions.description: Called at every sampling pass. discovery holds the interfaces the firewall reported (identifiers, devices); now is the pass's instant.
functions.name: sample

fields.description: Why the probe could not finish, when it could not.
fields.name: error

fields.description: The readings that did not answer, each named in words for the availability detail.
fields.name: missing

fields.description: Why the pass failed, when it did.
fields.name: error

fields.description: What is measured: a lower-case word with no space (interface, interface_endpoint, gateway, firewall, or the plugin's own).
fields.name: subject_kind

fields.description: What figure: a lower-case word with no space.
fields.name: measure

fields.description: Its unit: a lower-case word with no space.
fields.name: unit

fields.description: Whether the reading names this provider; false for the firewall reporting on itself. True when absent.
fields.name: attributed
